checkpoint.title: Five species, into the Research Lab

events.why: step 64: the lab gate asks for five registered species, 3/5 after the tutorial: two new ones here in Wild Zone 1 before leaving, Scatterbug (on the road at 100 from the far gate) and Mareep (in the grass right of the road at 60), so the gate's scene finds 5/5 (user, 2026-11-13; console B 2026-11-13 caught only Scatterbug with one wanted). Patrol 100, 60, 100, 60, ...: walking to 100 and back brings Pokemon back at 60; 10 visits, 10 minutes, 12 throws at most. Only the Pokedex's "Registered!" banner counts, since repeats (Fletchling, Bunnelby) do not register; the mission panel's counter is not read (catch_in_zone).

step 62: on across Wild Zone 1 to its far gate's "A Leave": back onto the road at the catch spots (60, and 100 first when further) and from there by the objective marker. A walk straight at the marker from the last catch (96) left the zone on its west side and pressed into a building, last read 49 (console B, 2026-11-13). On the marker with no prompt counts as through the gate (walk_to_zone_gate).
step 62: A Leave, out on the street (a plain scene step ends at once on the gate's prompt with the party bar up; console B, 2026-11-10)

step 63: across to the Pokemon Research Lab's gate, into Taunie's scene, by the objective marker: out of the zone's gate the player faces whichever way it faced before (the timed legs from 2026-11-08 depended on that; console B, 2026-11-10).
step 63: Taunie at the lab gate; with five species registered she goes on
step 65: Taunie's scene at the lab gate after 5/5
step 65: up the steps to the lab's "A Enter", by the objective marker.
steps 65-66: A Enter, the receptionist: third floor; autosave (A first: the door's prompt shows with the party bar up)

metadata.source: console B recording, 2026-11-08/09: played step by step from a new game
